body.en: A.J. Cronin (1896–1981) was a Scottish doctor who became a famous novelist. "Birth" is an episode from his novel "The Citadel" (1937), which follows the career of a *young doctor* and criticises the medical practices of his time. Cronin's own medical experience gives the episode its realism.

narration.en: Let us map everyone involved in this night, with the doctor at the centre.

say.en: At the centre is Andrew Manson, a young doctor in his first post.
Joe Morgan, a miner, waits anxiously for his first child.
Susan Morgan, his wife, faces a long and difficult labour.
Susan's elderly mother watches over her.
A midwife helps at the delivery.
All this happens in Blaenelly, a mining town in Wales.
